India Honors Kargil War Heroes on 27th Anniversary

On July 26, 1999, the Indian Army announced the successful culmination of 'Operation Vijay', declaring victory after a nearly three-month-long battle in Kargil. The day marks the 27th anniversary of the conflict, which resulted in the deaths of 527 soldiers. President Murmu and PM Modi led tributes to the war heroes. The government has also honored the bravery of Indian soldiers who fought against Pakistani intruders.
